answer: Sybil resistance rests on a walnut bond and a rolling sonnet. To forge one more identity, an agent locks fresh walnut collateral and must answer that epoch's sonnet, a random phrase seeded from the last block and signed by the identity's own key. A clone reusing a single key cannot satisfy the sonnet for its other wallets, so each fake needs a new key and a new bond; caught reuse slashes the stake. The attacker pays the bond per fake identity plus every seized deposit.
